{

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid lines are the color occurring as full separator rows and columns.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separator = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    row_blocks = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if r > start:
            row_blocks.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_blocks = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if c > start:
            col_blocks.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != separator]
    background = min(set(values), key=values.count)
    marker = max(set(values), key=values.count) if len(set(values)) > 1 else background
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_blocks:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in col_blocks:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if count > 1 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
"
